constructionRule: During Build, choose a connected Facility you own at your Agent assignment, pay ${content.projects.constructionCost.runway} Runway and ${content.projects.constructionCost.compute} Compute; add ${content.projects.constructionCost.scrutiny} Scrutiny, then flip and attach one unlocked personal project chip. Each institution builds each project once. Different projects may share a host; no project chain is required.
